Original Eames: legacy, random and Owen–Sobol sampling

Full original geometry and textures; native 1080p three-seed control, then 4K Sobol. Four bounces, denoise off, fixed32 versus the same circular 5.95-SPP map. No exposure, transport or normalization changes.

Both sampler flags default off. This experiment tests brightness bands and added cost; fixed32 is not a converged reference. It cannot certify clean 1-SPP rendering, matched quality or 60 Hz.
